meta.description: Learn sim racing one concept at a time: explanation, example, then exercise. The syllabus is ready; articles come later.

home.title: Get faster. One concept at a time.
home.subtitle: This is not an encyclopedia of articles. It is a path: concept, why it works, an example, and an exercise. Then the next concept.
home.methodBody: Every lesson uses the same structure. When we publish the content, you will enter, practice, and move on. Right now you can walk the empty shell.
home.stepConceptBody: What it is, in a definition you can use on track.
home.stepWhyBody: Weight, tire load, grip, and car rotation.
home.stepExampleBody: A specific corner, not an abstract case.
home.stepExerciseBody: Speed, pressure, and a measurable procedure.
home.curriculumBody: Six parts based on The Motor Racing Book (Suellio Almeida), plus mountain roads and setup. Guidelines and braking already have published content.
